collision_boundary.C185: C185 evolves a full symmetric matrix on a fixed isospectral orbit toward a separate diagonal target; C298 fixes A and evolves a rank-k projection/subspace under the induced linear action.
collision_boundary.subset_sum_warning: simple eigenvalues need not have distinct k-fold subset sums; uniqueness uses the representable-matroid greedy basis on actual support.

model.normalization: orthogonal projector represents an unoriented k-plane

nonclaims: No target arithmetic local datum, Euler factor, root number, automorphy, divisor law, functional equation, or zero match is asserted.
Plucker weights are finite-dimensional source exponents, not prime norms or target spectral zeros.
The symmetric generator A is not asserted to be a Hilbert--Polya operator.
No literary priority is claimed for Oja, Brockett, Grassmann power-flow, Schubert, or Morse--Bott mechanisms.

proof_contract.degenerate_limit: an eigenflag-adapted basis yields the associated graded subspace
proof_contract.finite_role: finite cases audit formulas and edge conventions but do not prove the global theorem
proof_contract.matroid_guard: nonzero Plucker indices are bases of a representable matroid; distinct element weights give a unique greedy maximum
proof_contract.morse_bott: within-block modes are tangent and cross-block modes have nonzero eigenvalue differences
proof_contract.quotient_flow: differentiate the orthogonal projector onto exp(tA)Ran(P0)
proof_contract.rate_guard: the gap is defined from actual nonzero Plucker support, not from the ambient subset list
proof_contract.tie_guard: arbitrary subset sums may tie and are never assumed distinct

theorem_contract.equilibria: all and only A-invariant rank-k orthogonal projections
theorem_contract.plucker: p_I(t) is projectively exp(t sum_{i in I}lambda_i)p_I(0)
theorem_contract.recurrence: Tr(AP) is strict off equilibria, excluding nonconstant recurrence
theorem_contract.repeated_spectrum: critical sets are product-Grassmann Morse-Bott manifolds and every orbit has an associated-graded limit
theorem_contract.simple_limit: each eigenflag Schubert cell converges to its greedy coordinate k-plane
theorem_contract.simple_rate: the actual second nonzero Plucker weight determines the exact exponential rate
